name: mindmap-view
description: XMind-like mind mapping custom editor for markdown files, with true bidirectional sync.

commands.title: Mind Map: Switch to Markdown Editor
Mind Map: Switch to Mind Map Editor

mindmapView.writeDebounceMs.description: How long to wait (ms) after your last edit in the map before writing it back to the file. Takes effect immediately for already-open maps.

mindmapView.externalEditForwardDebounceM.description: How long to wait (ms) after an external change to the file (e.g. edited in a split text editor) before refreshing an open map. Takes effect immediately for already-open maps.

mindmapView.animationNodeThreshold.description: Above this many visible nodes, fold/unfold position animations turn off and changes apply instantly. Takes effect the next time a map is opened.

mindmapView.headingDepth.description: Nodes at or above this depth are written as markdown headings; deeper nodes become list items. Root is depth 0 (always H1); the default (1) means first-level branches are H2. Takes effect the next time a map is opened.

enumDescriptions: Balance first-level branches left and right of the root
Place all first-level branches to the right of the root
Place all first-level branches to the left of the root
mindmapView.layoutMode.description: How first-level branches are arranged around the root. Takes effect the next time a map is opened.

mindmapView.pastedImageFolder.description: Folder, relative to the markdown file's own folder, where images pasted from the clipboard into the map are saved. Empty (the default) saves them alongside the file. Example: "assets". Read fresh on each paste, so it takes effect immediately.

scripts.build: tsc -noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc -noEmit -p tsconfig.webview.json && node esbuild.config.mjs production
